Code: IC 6-3-4-4.1
Enrolled Act: SEA 243, Sec. 17
Effective date: July 1, 2026
•

Clarifies that the estimated payment tax penalty for individual taxpayers is calculated by the
rate prescribed in IC 6-8.1-10-2.1(b), and not an amount prescribed in that statute as it
previously stated.
Legislative Synopsis 2026 | 18
